summary: Day 5 after an anterior resection with CT-confirmed PE and shock: systemic thrombolysis is not for this patient (major surgery within 3 weeks); anticoagulation ranks first.

inputs.chiefComplaint: Sudden breathlessness and collapse on the ward
inputs.hpi: Day 5 after laparoscopic anterior resection for rectal cancer. Sudden breathlessness, pleuritic chest pain and a pre-syncopal episode this morning.

imaging.name: CTPA
imaging.result: Saddle pulmonary embolus with right ventricular dilatation (RV:LV 1.4).

confirmedDiagnosis.name: High-risk pulmonary embolism 5 days after anterior resection
confirmedDiagnosis.assessmentText: High-risk PE with shock, post-operative day 5 after anterior resection.

match: re:not for this patient: systemic thrombolysis - .*3 weeks
redFlags.note: ESC 2019: major surgery within 3 weeks is a contraindication to systemic fibrinolysis — surgical embolectomy or catheter-directed treatment instead.

guideline.name: ESC guidelines — acute pulmonary embolism
guideline.section: Diagnostic strategy; reperfusion; contraindications to fibrinolysis
guideline.citation: Konstantinides SV et al. Eur Heart J 2020;41:543-603.

rationale: In high-risk PE after major surgery within 3 weeks, systemic thrombolysis is contraindicated; anticoagulate (UFH) and consider surgical embolectomy or catheter-directed treatment (ESC 2019).
